{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "Confident of a good CY2026 based on client conversation and AI leadership.",
      "made_in": "Jan 2026",
      "quote": "we are confident of a good CY2026",
      "outcome": "Revenue grew from ₹70,698 Cr (Mar 2026) to ₹73,188 Cr (Sep 2026); AI revenue reached $3.1B in Q2 FY27.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026 / Q2 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Accelerate deployment of five pillar AI strategy in FY27.",
      "made_in": "Apr 2026",
      "quote": "As we move into FY27, we will continue to accelerate deployment of our five pillar AI strategy.",
      "outcome": "Annualized AI revenue grew from $1.8B in Jan 2026 to $2.6B in Q1 FY27 and $3.1B in Q2 FY27.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Q2 FY27 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "International market to perform better in FY26 than FY25.",
      "made_in": "Jul 2026",
      "quote": "we are confident the international market will do better in FY '26 than FY '25. However, it is our aspiration to continue to drive growth in company overall growth itself.",
      "outcome": "FY2026 full year constant currency revenue growth was -2.4%, compared to positive growth in previous years.",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Q4 FY2026 reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Honor all job offers for the rest of the year.",
      "made_in": "Jul 2026",
      "quote": "We have honored all the job offers, and we'll do so for the rest of the year.",
      "outcome": "Workforce strength stood at 613,069 in Q1 FY26; no reported data on offer revocations.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Q1 FY26 reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Expect demand to improve sometime in Q2 FY27.",
      "made_in": "Jul 2026",
      "quote": "I expect the demand to improve sometime in Q2.",
      "outcome": "Q2 FY27 revenue rose to ₹73,188 Cr from ₹72,275 Cr, but CC growth slowed to 0.5% QoQ from 3.2% YoY.",
      "verdict": "partly",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Growth momentum will continue on a medium-term basis.",
      "made_in": "Oct 2026",
      "quote": "on a medium-term basis, looking at the TCV, looking at the pipeline and the client conversations that we are having, we're confident that growth momentum will continue.",
      "outcome": "Tracking: Q2 FY27 showed 2.8% YoY CC growth and $9.6B TCV, but horizon extends beyond current data.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Q2 FY27 call reported metrics"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 2,
    "partly": 1,
    "missed": 1,
    "summary": "Management shows high credibility in AI scaling but tends to be overly optimistic regarding international market recoveries and demand inflection points."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "AI narrative is strongly supported by numbers, with annualized revenue nearly doubling from $1.8B to $3.1B in three quarters.",
    "The 'good CY2026' narrative aligns with quarterly revenue growth from ₹70k Cr to ₹73k Cr.",
    "Operating margin narrative of 27% in financials slightly exceeds the 24-25% reported in call commentary for FY27.",
    "Demand improvement narrative in Q2 FY27 is only partially visible, as QoQ constant currency growth remained slim at 0.5%."
  ]
}
